records.researcher_notes: GEM's only gas unit at Riverside is CC_set, 723 MW from 2020, which is the newer West Riverside block (federal plant 64020, shared owners). The older block is missing. The federal monthly generator file for September 2026 (Operating sheet, plant 55641 Riverside Energy Center) lists CTG1 198.9 MW, CTG2 198.9 MW and STG1 277.1 MW, operating since June 2004 and owned by Wisconsin Power & Light Co, 674.9 MW in all. The state air permit for the site describes four gas-fired combined cycle turbines in all and a project to raise the 2004 block's output from 625 MW by replacing its turbine parts. The Public Service Commission draft Strategic Energy Assessment, Table B-8, counts that as 156 MW of Riverside upgrades in 2028, and MISO request J3156 (100 MW, Townline Road, Rock County) is its grid request. Seven 2,500 kilowatt Caterpillar black start engines (17.5 MW in Alliant's 2025 annual report) also sit at the site and are below the unit threshold.
